what: The five 96-key tasks (E147's saved updates, seeds 0-2, step 30) at ONE common update size, each beside a random update of the same size, read by the re-gating share (log-odds r and KL form), size, effective rank, R at head_mlp, mlp_attn, block, top neurons (p97) and VPD. One graph per reading, tasks on the x-axis by the base model's prior of the trained answer. Nothing is trained; no reuse verdict is given (the definition is under revision, cell P1.1).

settings.tasks_source: E147's five 96-key tasks (experiments/refit_96key/results/inventory.json maps): rank1 = 'top' (the base model's own most likely next token), elicit = 'mid' (a token in its top 20)
settings.seeds_source: every seed E147 saved (dW_<task>_s{0,1,2}.pt, step 30, one recipe)
settings.control_state_source: the task with the smallest mean size as E187 measured it (copy 0.00730, experiments/size_matched/results/m67.json); saved readings exist for it at every reading this run repeats (E228 states/e58_copy_s0.json, E221 items/e58-copy_s0_<level>.json)
settings.split_seed_source: E228's split_seed (experiments/random_kl_share/results/predictions.json), so the halves are E228's halves
settings.random_seed_source: new; state i of Config.states() draws its direction with random_seed + i. The construction is E228's (commute.finetune.random_direction: each matrix a Gaussian at the state's own per-matrix Frobenius norm), so a direction has its state's size matrix by matrix; times the state's c it has the scaled state's size exactly (user 2026-11-20 17:20: random control scaled to the same weight-norm size, at least 3 draws: here 3 per task, one per seed)
settings.band_source: E229's main band (experiments/topk_upper/results/predictions.json main_band); E229's filed settings are used unchanged for the top-neuron read, E221's for the coarse levels, E226's for VPD

matched_size_rule: size = ||dW|| / ||W0|| over the 24 decomposed matrices (E187's, computed by E205's sizes). Target = the smallest of the five task means over seeds; c_task = target / task mean; every state of a task and its random control are multiplied by c_task. The smallest task (c = 1) is read as saved. Expected from E187's sizes: copy smallest (0.007302), c rank1 0.920, cipher 0.752, prior_cipher 0.7798 (E187's own c for that pair, so prior_cipher's scaled states are E187's and E232's), elicit not measured before (stage 0 finds it; if it is the smallest the target moves to it and every c changes; no rule depends on which task is the target).

thresholds.thresholds_source: share_repro_tol: the largest gap measured between two code paths reading r on the same rows of these 15 states, 7.9e-4 (E228's re-read against E147's saved r, rank1_s1, experiments/random_kl_share/results/states), rounded up; here the path is E228's own, so a miss is a wrong state, row set or split. R_repro_tol: E221's repro_tol (E232 repeated E221's items with difference 0, experiments/kstar_size_matched/results/stage0_pod*.json). size_match_rel: E232's (the same function on the same tensors times one scalar). erank_rel: E187's (erank is scale-free; E187 measured scaled/unscaled 1 - 4e-11). kind_gap_min: half the smallest of the six saved r gaps between {copy, rank1, elicit} and {cipher, prior_cipher}, elicit - prior_cipher 0.349 (E228 states, task means). topk_range: E229's filed P1 range (its 20 trained items read 0.988-0.998). vpd_range: E226's e58 items read 0.99890-0.99938 (experiments/kstar_vpd/results/items/e58-*.json); the upper end 0.99999 puts the do-nothing (exactly 1) outside.

rules.placement: Where prior_cipher sits on a reading, from the three seeds of prior_cipher, cipher and copy at the common size: 'with cipher' when |mean pc - mean cipher| < |mean pc - mean copy| and pc and copy separate by E51's rule (commute.elicit.separation, min_gap 0: |gap of means| strictly over the larger seed range); 'with copy' when nearer copy and pc and cipher separate; otherwise 'no call'; 'unreadable' when any of the nine seeds is missing or not finite. prior_cipher's prior is 1.6 times under copy's and 22 times over cipher's: a reading that tracks the prior puts it with copy; one that tracks the task's kind (a cipher of the key) puts it with cipher. Edge cases: the do-nothing (every R exactly 1) reads 'no call' (distances 0 and 0, not strictly smaller); equal distances read 'no call'; a zero seed range on both sides separates on any non-zero gap.
rules.kind_gap: E51's rule with min_gap kind_gap_min (0.17) on r for each of the six cells {copy, rank1, elicit} x {cipher, prior_cipher}: 'a_higher' when the first task's mean is higher by over both the larger seed range and 0.17. An unreadable seed fails the cell.
rules.against_band: A task's three seeds all below its random band's minimum ('below') or all above its maximum ('above'); None when the band or a seed is not read.
rules.spearman: Reported, no rule: Spearman's rank correlation over the five task means of each reading against log10 prior (n = 5: a perfect order happens by chance once in 120). As saved, r's order gives 0.9 (copy and elicit swap).

blind_to.r: changes that leave the trained answer's log-odds alone (r is NaN under a gain of 1 log-odds, so the random update has no r band)
blind_to.kl_share: which tokens the KL moves on: it sums over every position up to the read position
blind_to.R: a mechanism outside the featurization's variables; R rises with a smaller update at every level (E232), which is why every task is read at one size
blind_to.size_erank: everything but the weights: no forward pass
blind_to.prior: the update: one number per task from the base model

noise_floor: seed range per task (three seeds); E228's pooled seed sd of r over these five tasks 0.0124 (card), its split-half band of r 0.0465 and of kl_share 0.0053 (experiments/random_kl_share/results/score.json bands); coarse R seed ranges as saved 0.0003-0.0024 (E221 items).
positive_control: the repeats at c = 1 (stage 0): the same reader on the same state must reproduce the saved readings; and r on copy against cipher separates as saved (0.47 apart, seed ranges under 0.02).
